text: Explain the choices as engineering decisions, not decoration. Static hybrid analysis was chosen because the input is an APK and package/hash-only evidence is fragile. Maven references were chosen because exact versions are required for SBOM and CVE work. CycloneDX and PURL provide interoperability. OSV aligns with Maven package/version queries. R8 is treated as confidence-affecting because perfect resilience is not supported by the evidence.

text: This is the actual MVP architecture. The main APK lane extracts and analyzes evidence, the separate Maven lane builds comparable versioned profiles, and both meet at the hybrid matcher. A confidence gate sits before CycloneDX and OSV so uncertain version evidence cannot become a strong vulnerability claim. The separation also makes the system reproducible: reference construction can evolve without hiding matcher behavior.
